rule: Schema-only supplement to OUTPUT_SCHEMA_C4V003.json: every literal string the output of classifier_a_c4v003 can carry, grouped by the field that carries it, each group with the code location (function, and module constant where there is one) it comes from. It carries no implementation and no expected case output. Values written with %s or %d are the code's own format templates: the marked part is formatted in at run time from an input or a computed value (Python's str() of it, so None prints as None). A value printed by more than one field is listed under each field group that carries it. Echoed input content (marked ECHO in the schema) is not listed: its words are the producer's.

groups.from: module constant OUT_SCHEMA; classify_bundle, Run.run, Run.prescore_output, Run.score_output
module constant NAME; classify_bundle, Run.run, Run.prescore_output, Run.score_output

groups.note: BUNDLE_UNREADABLE:%s carries the OSError text or a strict-loader word (group 'strict loader words'); BUNDLE_KEYS:%s the Python list repr of the sorted symmetric difference with the seven bundle keys; BUNDLE_PIN:%s an input role name (module constant INPUT_ROLES).
The exception class name and the first 300 characters of its message (Python's text).

NON_FINITE_CONSTANT takes NaN, Infinity or -Infinity (the json module's constant names); NON_FINITE_NUMBER the overflowing literal; JSON_SYNTAX the Python exception class name (JSONDecodeError, RecursionError, or ValueError for an integer beyond Python's 4300-digit limit, OC-31).

groups.field: load status words (prescore not_stop_inputs.*; agreement.agree_record_defect; inside stop details)
groups.from: Run.load_inputs, Run.read_pinned (load_err); Run.prescore_output prints load_err or 'READ'
the bundle's mode, checked by Run.load_bundle; printed by Run.run, Run.prescore_output, Run.score_output

values: no NGC call: no classification (engine terminal status or NO_IDENTIFIED_DIRECTION; A133 1.3)

groups.field: stops[].code and status_code: the other stop codes, with their class
groups.from: Run.check_tsr (TSR_FLAG_TABLE_MISMATCH, class TSR); Run.check_gate_list and Run.run (GATE_STATUS_LIST_DEFECT, class GATE); Run.check_envelope (FIELD_DEFECT_ENVELOPE, class ENVELOPE); Run.check_sensitivity (FIELD_DEFECT_SENSITIVITY, class SENSITIVITY); Run.run over Run.build_rows (FIELD_DEFECT_ROW, class ROW); Run.check_alternatives, Run.prepare_alternatives (FIELD_DEFECT_ALTERNATIVE, class ALT)

groups.field: stops[].detail words for the refused phase inputs (PHASE_MISMATCH)
groups.note: No new stop code (F5's list is closed); the word is printed in the PHASE_MISMATCH detail (OC-29). The record's named phase is kept as the run's phase (OC-27).

values: %s bytes do not hash to the sealed sha
stage0_successor bytes do not hash to the sealed sha
tsr_flag_record bytes do not hash to the sealed sha
phase inputs record: PHASE1_HEADER_MISSING (a scored Phase 1 needs phase1_header, which carries the L1 sha logged at the Phase-1 freeze; C-1.1 L1 map row; V-F4)
phase inputs record: RUN_STATUS_NOT_OF_PHASE (%s is not a run status of %s; C-I7; V-F5)
phase inputs record missing or malformed (%s)
manifest input_bindings.calibration_record.path missing or not absolute
Phase-1 and Phase-2 registry roots are not disjoint
score entry names %s; manifest calibration record gives %s
groups.note: RUN_STATUS_NOT_OF_PHASE takes the run status (AT0A_FAILED or HALTED) and the named phase; 'missing or malformed' takes the phase inputs' load status or None; the last template takes two phase words.
The first is the template; the others are the code's own messages formatted into it; a TypeError, KeyError or float() ValueError raised by Python formats its own text instead.

values: compare schema or failing ring list
failing TRUNCATION_SHAPE rings are not exactly {ordinal 15}
failing non-TRUNCATION_SHAPE rings are not empty
%s not pinned among the freeze input files
flag record not pinned among the freeze input files
flag record scope, rule or ring
flag record flags are not 43 booleans in manifest order
flag record flags are not exactly {NGC3198-Q25}
support record scope or compare pin
support record is not one ring entry
support record native_ring is not the compare ordinal-15 record verbatim
support record bounds are not (r_14, r_16) exclusive
groups.note: 'flag record %s is not %s' and '%s not pinned among ...' take the pin key (ntest_compare_pin, n1_record_pin, gl_node_record_pin) and the first 8 hex of its sha (6f095f64, 8867c376, ec1dcca5); '(%s)' takes a load status or None.

values: root-listed gate %s of roster %s not on the list
gate %s of this INVALID row is not on the gate-status list
groups.note: Gate shas print as their first 12 lower-case hex; the row-level detail is '<query id>: gate <12 hex> of this INVALID row is not on the gate-status list'.

values: manifest reference member not unique among manifest members
freeze manifest schema %r is not %s, the schema of the freeze module the seal names for %s (M-5 addition 2; A154)
synthetic score could not be built from the frozen manifest: %s
groups.note: 'freeze manifest schema %r ...' (Run.check_manifest_schema) takes the manifest's schema value in Python's repr (a quoted string, None, or another value's repr), the schema the phase needs (FREEZE_MANIFEST_C2V003G; FREEZE_MANIFEST_C2V003G_STAGE0_C2V002 in successor mode) and the phase (PHASE_1 or PHASE_2; in successor mode the text 'PHASE_2 with the STAGE0 successor pinned'). The last takes a Python exception class name (prescore).

sigma_ratio null on a within-error row (finite value required)
gate registration of an INVALID_AS_MISS row not readable from the frozen manifest
groups.note: '%s missing' takes score_status, within_error, sigma_ratio, registered_reason or status.

values: STAGE0_GRID_OUTER: STAGE0 status record missing or malformed

STAGE0_GRID_OUTER: evaluated by the receipt rule but not scored
no unique twin with the reference log_index
groups.note: '%s: %s' takes the alternative and either the comma-joined failing fields (kind, status, role, scored, scoring_scope, members, in that order) or a twin message (the last three values, or the twin's row messages '<query id>: <message>' joined by '; ', with the FIELD_DEFECT_ROW and GATE_STATUS_LIST_DEFECT row messages). The frozen-block template (Run.prepare_alternatives, successor mode) takes the block defect word (group 'STAGE0 block defect words').
